text:
Type: galvanized steel plant pot
Use: holding a potted plant or herbs on a windowsill, shelf or floor; kitchen, living room, balcony
Style: industrial, farmhouse, rustic
Materials: galvanized steel with a shiny metallic finish
Colors: silver grey metal
Shape: round bucket-like pot tapering toward the base, rolled rim, ribbed horizontal grooves around the body, compact and light
Feel: practical, fresh, casual, utilitarian
Goes with: green plants, raw wood, white walls, terracotta; industrial, farmhouse or rustic rooms and balconies

product.name: SOCKER
product.description: The plant pot is galvanised to protect against corrosion.
